exposure: Length of time to complete the 3-hour glucose tolerance test (GTT) after the 1-hour glucose challenge test (GCT) (categorized as <=14 days vs >14 days)
outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (large for gestational age, shoulder dystocia, birth injury, respiratory distress, hypoglycemia, fetal/neonatal death)
cohort: Singleton, nonanomalous individuals screened for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) at >=24 weeks' gestation at an academic hospital system.
finding: The length of time to complete the two-step GDM screening (<=14 vs >14 days) was not associated with an increased rate of the composite adverse neonatal outcome or secondary adverse outcomes.
gest_age: >=24 weeks' gestation at time of GDM screening
